title: Restore products in localhost preview
summary: Replace disconnected local product reads with a read-only snapshot of the public storefront catalog.

changes.detail: Local-only launcher downloads published products through the public API, serves catalog reads on loopback, rejects writes, and isolates credentials from dotenv. Production application code unchanged.
